extracted.intended_audience: PR professionals, communications and marketing teams, and anyone writing or distributing press releases
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for creating and formatting engaging press releases intended to attract journalists and target audiences, emphasizing headline, content, newsline selection, and required contact information. Based on PR Newswire's data-backed recommendations for optimal distribution and engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crafting an effective headline
rubrics_metrics.description: How to craft a headline that is best suited to your press release content
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PR Newswire emphasizes creating a headline tailored to the release content; the guide contains data-backed recommendations on headline construction to maximize engagement. (No detailed examples on the landing page.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Include content that appeals to journalists
rubrics_metrics.description: What to include in your press release that appeals to journalists
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guide promises advice on which elements journalists look for. Ensure the release highlights news value and provides clear, journalist-friendly information. The landing page notes these elements are covered in the ebook.

rubrics_metrics.name: Choosing the right newsline
rubrics_metrics.description: Why choosing the right newsline is critical to receiving engagement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selecting an appropriate newsline (placement/category) is presented as critical for engagement and distribution; the guide explains how the newsline affects who sees and responds to the release.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design for target-audience engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: The press release ... should be designed to maximize engagement with your target audience
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Releases should be structured and worded with the target audience in mind to maximize engagement. The landing page frames the guide as providing best practices to achieve this.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete required fields and contact information
rubrics_metrics.description: Note that each field is required, including contact phone number below your name.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When preparing/submitting a release, fill every required field and include a contact phone number placed below the contact name. This is an explicit submission/format requirement called out on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format for optimal success
rubrics_metrics.description: If you’ve ever wondered how to format your press release for optimal success, we have put all of our data-backed recommendations into a comprehensive guide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The landing page promises a compiled, data-backed set of formatting recommendations intended to improve press-release performance; specifics are in the ebook rather than on the page itself.
